hook: Black Ops III, recompiled natively for Apple Silicon

beats.say: bo3mac statically recompiles the Steam Mac build of Call of Duty Black Ops III into a native arm64 app.
It swaps the old Direct3D 11 translation layer for Metal and MetalFX, so the game keeps running after Rosetta 2 goes away.
The installer checks your own Steam copy and compiles locally. The MIT licensed repo ships no game files, so you must own the game.
